name: Night Game
description: Clean translucent cards, kinetic type, split-screen matchup, player spotlight, diamond transition and four scorebug layouts. Also: stat bars and cards, pitching comparisons, game final and summary, matchup banner and split, side panels, automatic home run / wild pitch stingers and show graphics.
